name: Roguefeather Den
summary: In the southern cliffs of Thousand Needles, Roguefeather harpies guard their roost. Deep in the cavern, they keep scavenged provisions and stolen supplies.

sections.title: A Roost in the Canyons
sections.body: Among the sandstone bluffs of southern Thousand Needles, Roguefeather harpies guard their roost. Their screeching carries through the cavern as they defend the food and stolen supplies gathered in its dark recesses.

faq.answer: Along the southern cliffs of Thousand Needles, Roguefeather Den shelters a small cavern where Roguefeather harpies roost and store supplies.
Hostile, screeching harpies inhabit the cavern. They fiercely defend their nesting grounds and gathered food.

faq.q: What is kept deep inside Roguefeather Den?
aliases: what is in the back of the cave
faq.answer: Deep in the cavern, the harpies keep scavenged and stolen food. They guard it fiercely.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler heading toward the Shimmering Flats, you face an aggressive flock that threatens from the air. They can ambush you along the southern canyon floor.
